title: Volume of production per labour unit by classes of farming/pastoral/forestry enterprise size
national_indicator_available: National data are currently unavailable for this indicator.
national_indicator_description: As noted in the [Forward Looking Joint Sector Review Report for Fiscal Year 2023/2024](https://www.minagri.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Minagri/Publications/Annual_Reports/MINAGRI_-_JSR_Report_for_2023-24_FY.pdf), this indicator is among the SDG indicators not currently monitored by the Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Resources. However, relevant information may be found in the [Agricultural Household Survey](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/surveys/Agricultural-Household-Survey) and [Seasonal Agricultural Survey](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/surveys/Seasonal-Agricultural-Survey) conducted by the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR).
indicator_definition: Volume of agricultural production of small-scale food producer in crop, livestock, fisheries, and forestry activities per number of days worked. The indicator is computed as a ratio of annual output to the number of working days in one year.
